Greeting.title: Greeting
Greeting.subtitle: Greeting
Greeting.lead: Thank you for visiting the OT SCIENCE website.
Greeting.p1: Surface treatment (plating) is designated as one of Korea's root industries, together with casting, molds, welding, plastic working and heat treatment. Root industries are the basic industries that produce parts and finished products, and they form the foundation of manufacturing competitiveness.
Greeting.p2: Plating requires equipment and jigs, the chemicals applied to the surface of the workpiece, water to rinse the workpiece, and then a wastewater treatment facility to purify the rinse water contaminated by those chemicals.
Greeting.p3: Our company manufactures and imports the equipment, jigs and chemicals used in the plating process, and we also recover and refine the precious metals (gold, silver and palladium) contained in the rinse water generated during plating.
Greeting.p4: Drawing on the skills and experience we have accumulated on the plating floor, we promise to develop and manufacture technology that reflects our customers' needs and to contribute to the growth of the surface-treatment industry.
Greeting.signature: Kim Young-chul, CEO, OT SCIENCE Co., Ltd.
Greeting.imageAlt: OT SCIENCE headquarters and metallic materials research institute

Chemicals.title: Plating Chemicals
Chemicals.subtitle: Specially Designed Plating Chemicals
Chemicals.intro: From pre-treatment to post-treatment, we develop and manufacture additives optimized for each step of the plating process. We hold a hazardous chemicals manufacturing license, ISO 9001:2015 and INNO-BIZ certification.

Metals.title: Precious Metals Recovery & Refining
Metals.subtitle: Precious Metals Recovery and Refining
Metals.intro: We recover and refine gold, silver, palladium and other precious metals contained in plating rinse water using electrolytic and adsorption systems. This is the founding business of OT SCIENCE, launched in 2002 with our recovery system patent.

electrolytic.title: Electrolytic Recovery System
electrolytic.desc: Precious-metal ions in rinse water are deposited on the cathode by electrolysis and recovered at high purity.

adsorption.title: Adsorption Recovery System
adsorption.desc: Precious metals are captured on adsorbents such as ion-exchange resin and recovered through a refining process.
